fact: On 31 October 2025 ANIP launched an operation to register deaths not declared between 1 November 2017 and 6 November 2025 in the national register of persons, with death acts issued in ANIP units in town halls, and made declaring a death before a funeral permanent under article 31 of law 2020-34.
title: Bénin : l'ANIP appelle les familles à déclarer les décès non enregistrés depuis 2017
